Bring back the Great Debate

Your debate house can become a project starting point. Follow an idea into later societies, compare rival answers, or test it against what rulers actually did.

Ru · Confucian tradition

Kongzi, Mengzi, Xunzi, Zhu Xi · Character, education, family, and good government. Compare their disagreements about human nature.

Texts: Analects; Mengzi; Xunzi; Zhu Xi excerpts

Mo · Mohist tradition

Mozi · Impartial care, useful spending, and opposition to aggressive war.

Texts: Mozi

Dao · Daoist traditions

Laozi, Zhuangzi · Forced order, ambition, freedom, and the limits of intervention.

Texts: Laozi; Zhuangzi

Fa · Legalism

Shang Yang, Han Feizi · Law, incentives, punishment, agriculture, and state power.

Texts: Book of Lord Shang; Han Feizi

Fo · Buddhist traditions

Huiyuan, Wŏn’gwang · Suffering, religious commitments, family duties, and obligations to rulers.

Texts: Huiyuan; Wŏn’gwang account
